test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

The Department of Educational Policy is __committed__ to the study of educational policy, analyse, and evaluate educational programmes, to identify trends, understand outcomes and guide policy and practice, towards finding solutions to current problems in educational governance and management.
solution: The correct answer is: **Dedicated** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Committed** means fully pledged or devoted. (पूर्णतः प्रतिज्ञाबद्ध या समर्पित) • **Example**: *She is committed to finishing the project on time.* • Marked option **Dedicated **means devoted and focused on a particular purpose. (किसी विशेष उद्देश्य के प्रति समर्पित और केंद्रित) • **Example**: *The team is dedicated to achieving excellence in their work.* • Hence, it is clear that 'Committed' and 'dedicated' are synonyms Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Affiliated **means being associated or connected with something. (किसी चीज़ से जुड़ा या जुड़ा होना) • **Inclined **means having a tendency or preference towards something. (किसी चीज़ के प्रति प्रवृत्ति या प्राथमिकता होना) • **Apathetic **means showing a lack of interest or concern towards something. (किसी चीज़ के प्रति रुचि या चिंता की कमी दिखाना) 14f:T913, The correct answer is: **Monotonous**.
